content: Speak well of the dead, but walk with vigilant care among the living.
author: Celtic & Norse Proverbs
explanation: Honor the ancestors and leave the departed in peace; their accounts with heaven are closed. But among the living—where human vanity, hidden agendas, and changing loyalties abound—walk with clear eyes, healthy boundaries, and active discernment.
practicalInsight: Protect your boundaries and exercise healthy discernment in your professional and financial dealings today.
reflectionPrompt: Where have you been overly gullible, confusing naive trust with genuine virtue?
